title: Goodwill Schedule for Late Recovery Resets — Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
# Goodwill schedule for late recovery resets

Harborline's published goodwill schedule for late recovery resets credits goodwill to the account, without the customer having to ask, when the reset of the account's most recent approved recovery request was applied late after the request's waiting period ended. The applied reset is the account's security-change notice that followed the request's decision.

## Grant conditions

- Goodwill credit may be granted only while the account status is active.
- One grant may be made per affected holding or charge reference.
- The grant is posted against the reference of that security-change notice, with no product category.
- Where the amount the schedule yields is zero, nothing is owed and no entry is posted.

## Tool reference

The goodwill is recorded with the agent-side tool `grant_reset_delay_goodwill_979fb2c3`. Unlock it first and then call it; it is run by the agent, not handed to the customer. One call records one goodwill credit on the customer's Harborline account credit, posted against the reference of the account's security-change notice that applied the reset, with no product category: the account credit balance goes up by the goodwill amount and the goodwill appears on the account's credit history at once, spendable on any Harborline product and never withdrawable.

## Parameter table

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | The reference number of the customer's Harborline account, as shown on the account record opened for this customer. | Identifier, as shown on the record |
| `source_charge_ref` | The reference of the security-change notice, character for character, as shown on the account's history. | Reference exactly as shown on the record; the empty string is not used |
| `amount` | The goodwill credited, in US dollars. | A positive figure with 2 decimal places; any further decimals are rounded half up to the cent |

## Outcome of a call

A completed call returns a confirmation line beginning "Goodwill credited", stating the reference number of the new goodwill entry, the amount credited in US dollars with two decimals, the reference it was posted against and the account's new credit balance in US dollars with two decimals.

The call is refused with an error line when `amount` is not a positive US dollar figure, or when `source_charge_ref` is not the security-change notice reference unchanged (empty, padded with spaces or containing a space).

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts*
